gaps.lead: It would be sensible to leave before the traffic builds up.
gaps.sentence: We ___ before the traffic builds up.
gaps.explanation: 'It would be sensible to do' = 'we had better do' — had better + bare infinitive.

gaps.lead: Reporters expect the trial to last several weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Reporters expect it to last' becomes 'it is expected to last'.

gaps.lead: The flat was too cramped for their three children.
gaps.sentence: The flat wasn't ___ their three children.
gaps.explanation: too cramped for = not spacious enough for.

gaps.lead: Perhaps she never received our message.
gaps.explanation: may/might have + participle = possibility in the past.

gaps.lead: No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: The staff wear a uniform at all times.
gaps.sentence: The staff ___ a uniform at all times.
